about_the_game:
Those Who Dwell is a first-person claustrophobic folk horror game set in a dark, twisted labyrinth beneath the earth about isolation, light, and long forgotten things.

You are alone in a excavation site deep beneath the earth. The team that once worked here is gone and something older has been discovered and awakened. Navigate a network of twisting tunnels, ancient chambers, and abandoned dig sites as you piece together the fate of the excavators… and what they disturbed.

Stay in the light. Oil is scarce. Light fades. Some things only move when it’s dark.

Restore lost shrines to push back the gloom and earn the favor of the Hidden Folk, if they still watch.

Environmental Storytelling. Discover cave paintings, tools, and old maps that tell the story of those who came before and those who were here long before them.

Gameplay Highlights:

  • Atmospheric slow-burn horror with no combat

  • Light-based resource survival: manage oil, candles, and visibility

  • Shrine interaction system: restore, ignore, or desecrate — your choices change the outcome

  • Hidden endings and secrets for those who explore thoroughly

  • 10 handcrafted levels, each with evolving environmental storytelling

Face the darkness. Endure the isolation. And uncover the truth before you disappear too.

This is an in-progress version of the game. Some features or polish may not be final. Content will continue to be updated leading up to full release.

short_description: A slow-burning claustrophobic folk horror set deep underground. Light is your only hope as you explore deeper into a cursed cave system disturbed by those who dug too deep. Restore shrines, survive the dark, and uncover what became of Those Who Dwell.
